balls.text: Another wicket to finish. Wide and shortish, Rashid looked to cut it over point, top edged it right up. Bowler runs forward in follow-through and pouches it easily
Wide and slow again, Tewatia slashes this time. Looks to go square, gets it to the left of short third. Aniket races across and slides full length to take a good catch
Wide and fullish, goes for the full-fledged reverse sweep. Almost a slog, misses
Full toss down leg. Tewatis goes across and helps it over short fine with a lap shot. Harsha Bhogle predicted that on air too. Missed yorker from Unadkat, got it around knee-height.

Plops a wide full toss to deep midwicket. Just over shin-height, not far from the off-side tramline. Washington did go across and went for the slog sweep. Got it high. Easy catch for Reddy. Ends a laboured knock
Slower bouncer sits up. Goes straight on, Washington waits and pulls it hard over midwicket. Effectively a free hit. 73 metre six
Into the pitch and it's heaved across the line. Sails over wide long-on. Shortish slower ball was close to the off-side tramline. Shahrukh leant out and got it off the bottom. Went far anyway
Makes room, Cummins goes slower bouncer outside off. Shahrukh reaches out for the upper cut. Misses
Buttler goes across but Cummins follows him and has him hole out to long-on. Bowled full and wide, Buttler got low and had a low swipe

Head drops a low catch to the left at cover. He tried to take it with both hands but it popped out, he landed on his thigh and slid across without control. Was a full, wide ball that was cover driven. Off the toe of the bat
Pulled hard, on the bounce to deep midwicket. Was a 115ks slower bouncer that turned in a bit and finished on fourth stump
Short and wide, cut hard but off the bottom of the bat. Rolls to deep point

Buttler special. So still while winding his torso and cracking it with a horizontal bat swipe. Was a length ball around fifth but Buttler made it look like it was much closer to the stumps. Mid-on was in
Buttler goes across to fifth stump, gets a shin-high slower full toss that he short-arms sweeps through fine leg. Had to wait on that
Wide and full, slashed along the ground through extra. Pace on from Harshal
Wide low full toss. Slow too. Washington reaches out and sweeps to long-on
Wide and fullish, slapped to long-off
Wide slow yorker, jammed to cover
Good-batter stuff. Opens up a new area after one fails. Shifts his stance and reverse sweeps a similar ball to the last one, over short third
Away from the arc does it. Length ball wide and slow. Spins away too. Buttler looks to carve it over extra, misses.
Wide, full and slow. 85ks. Slashed just over the in-field at cover
Cuts hard to long-off's left. Touch short, there was width on that
Pulled with weight on the front foot. One of those Klaasen-esque quasi-pulls. Not that short a ball, zipping in at leg stump. Buttler cleared the front leg and launched it over midwicket
Smart from Zeeshan but doesn't work out. Buttler crawled to the leg-side tramline, so he went full and wide. Went just past the tramline
Gets away with the short ball. 95ks well outside off, Washington pulled to long-on.
Wide on a shortish length, belted to long-off
Goes for the reverse launch, misses. Premeditated from Buttler. Got square-on with feet wide apart but couldn't make contact with the length ball around sixth
Buttler goes across early, Cummins goes slower bouncer further away on the off side. Buttler manages to pull it across. Off the lower-half of the bat but races along the ground through midwicket
Extra bounce gets the leading edge, pops well over the bowler and rolls to long-on. Was a back of length ball around off that Washington looked to clip to midwicket
Looks for the yorker. Ends up a full ball on off, whipped to long-on
Wide on a length, cut through cover. Reddy at sweeper cover runs right to stop it. Likely a slower one
Buttler charges, Unadkat goes slower bouncer. It lands around off and spins away a touch, Buttler has to delay his pull a bit. Gets it along the ground to deep midwicket
Cutter spins in off a length. Lands around seventh and finishes on fifth. Punched off the front foot through cover
Flicks the fullish ball on leg through backward square leg. Deep fine stops it. 129ks

Tennis-ball bounce. Washington jumps up but lets it go on height. Not given wide, so he'll review. Given wide in fact. SRH review. Was a bouncer outside off. Replay of the wrong ball shows first up. Anyway, the line will also be checked. Landed veery short, was just inside the off-side tramline. Now the height check. Washington's head is 1.92 metres tall, ball went 1.94. So, it will be wide
Length on fourth, pushed towards cover
Wide on a length, looked slow, cut to deep point
Length on fourth, punched to long-off
Works the full ball to long-on's right
Full on off, worked to long-on
Goes back and works it leg side. Not much bounce on that
Low full toss outside off, pushed to deep point
Works the full ball back to the bowler
Length on leg, clipped off the back foot to long-on

Klaasen helps the ball onto the stumps and appeals for a run out. Wow, Gill's short. Third ump's checking the ball hit the stumps and not the keeper's gloves. Looks like the ball made contact with the edge of the stumps but the gloves are close too. Smart from the third ump - he's checking if the direction of the ball changed after it hit the stumps. Indeed it has. Gill has to go. The throw was from Harshal at short fine leg, Klaasen was behind the stumps, stuck his right hand out but instead of catching the ball he deflected it. Looked like a regulation run. Neither batter hurried, Gill tried to slide the bat through and was short. Was a googly on a length that spun back in sharply and was flicked from leg stump
Full on leg, clipped through square leg
Unadkat charges to the right from long-on, slides and parries it over him. Deep midwicket dives but can't stop it. Was a full ball that was flicked hard along the ground
Smart bowling but Gill uses his reach to flap it wide of long-off. Aniket charges and palms it back in the field on the bounce. Gill charged early there and Zeeshan bowled full, wide and slow
Pulled to deep square leg. Similar ball, a touch shorter if anything. 96ks
Length on leg, flat, flicked to deep midwicket. Was a legbreak
Wide on a length, cut hard to deep point. Four slower ones to finish

Cummins backtracks at cover... and drops it. He moved to the left from mid-off, had his back to the crowd, arched his back and tried to take it above head with both hands. Got nothing on it. Slower ball was wide and fullish, the line was what created the miscue. Buttler looked to slash it over extra but had to reach too far forward and toed it.
Another slower ball, two this over now. Wide on a length, cut to deep point
Edge... doesn't carry to the keeper. Gill tried cutting a fourth-stump length ball, went a touch too early and got a feather. Keeper leant forward but got half-volleyed. Was an offcutter
Flicked through midwicket, back-lift rises in third's direction and the downswing comes with power. The full ball angled in at middle and raced along the ground
133ks to start. Full on fourth, drilled to mid-off's left
Flatter ball, swatted through midwicket. Shortish length on fourth at 97ks, Gill has his weight forward and waits for the ball to reach beside him before pulling it flat
Length on off, punched to long-off
Sweeps a ball a touch fuller to deep square leg. This one was on middle
Inside out between long-off and deep cover. Gill danced down and picked the loopy length ball off middle stump.
Length on leg, 91ks, goes straight. Flicked off the back foot to deep midwicket
Wide on a length, driven softly to deep cover
n the blockhole on off at 141kph, Gill digs it out towards long-on
Creams this drive through extra cover to bring up his fifty! It's taken him just 25 balls. Skips out to this full ball outside off and drives this between mid-off and cover
Full outside off, driven to mid-off's right
Shami's horror day out continues. Buttler shimmies his shoulders and gets across the stumps early. This is on a length outside off and Buttler just effortlessly ramps this fine on the leg side
Short of length outside off, short-arm jabbed to deep square leg

Gill looks to take on this full ball outside off but can't middle it. Drags it between long-on and deep midwicket and the ball lands safely. Long-on is able to get across to prevent the boundary. But Abhishek, as he puts in the dive and tries to push the ball away, may have been touching the boundary rope. And it looks like that is the case. Gill gets the boundary
Legbreak on a length outside off, Buttler slaps it to extra cover
Tossed up outside off, Gill cruches a drive past the cover fielder and gets a single to deep cover
Tossed full on middle, driven down to long-on
Legbreak outside off, pushed towards cover for a single
Floated full on leg, clipped out towards deep midwicket
Hammered down the ground! That's classic Buttler. This is a half-volley outside off, Buttler clears his front leg and launches it straight down
Worked to the leg side for a single

Has that dropped short, or did he just drop it? It's a wobble seam delivery outside off, Buttler looks to drive and his bat twists in his hands as he ends up hitting it towards mid-off. Unadkat looks to take it low in front, but it bounces just in front!
On a length outside off, Gill punches it out to deep point
Full outside off, flicked away through midwicket
Full outside off, driven to mid-off's left
Length ball outside off, Gill fends at it chops it on the ground to is right. They manage a quick single
Googly tossed full around off, Buttler clips this into the vacant midwicket region and they do very well to run two

Zeeshan with the breakthrough! Googly outside off, Sudharsan looks to run it down fine on the off side but just manages an edge and the ball settles in Klaasen's gloves! First over after the powerplay, SRH get a wicket
Dropped short around off, it goes on with the angle to give Sudharsan room to free his arms and slap this down the ground. Good stop by Harshal at long-off running to his left
Arm ball around middle, clipped out through backward square
Sudharsan backs away and whips this length ball on leg to deep midwicket
On a length around off, Gill stays low and swats this through square leg
On a length outside off, Sudharsan stands tall and punches to cover
Short of length around leg, tucked out through square leg
Full outside off, flicked towards midwicket and they complete a risky single
Length ball around off, tapped towards cover for a quick single
So skillfully played! Slower bouncer on leg, Gill waits on it and just plays a gentle pull that beats short fine leg to his left and Shami can't chase this down
Effortless! This is a length ball angled across and Gill brings out that short-arm jab through midwicket!
This is some display. Short of length ball outside off and angled across Sudharsan, who helps it through backward square leg for the fourth boundary of the over
Put away! Full toss just outside off, around hip height, and Sudharsan whips it away over midwicket
Length ball outside off, Sudharsan deftly steers it to short third's left. This should have been fielded, but Unadkat is a bit slow in getting down to stop it and it slips through!
Full outside off, Gill tucks it in front of square
Full outside off, pace off again, Sudharsan pushes it to cover's right and sneaks it past the fielder for a single
This has been some sumptuous batting in this powerplay! This is a slower ball, full around off. Sudharsan leans across and hits the perfect straight drive!
Shot of the day! This is full on off, Gill gets his front foot forward and across to the pitch of the ball and whips it mercilessly over midwicket
Now Cummins fires a full toss down leg and Gill can't connect on the flick
Full toss around leg, Sudharsan tucks it behind square leg
Better lengths now from Cummins. Gill taps this into the cover area for a quick run
On a length outside off, steered to backward point. Sudharsan wanted the single and has to scamper back as Gill sends him back
This is even better from Gill! Overpitched outside off and Gill hits a cracking drive through extra cover. Perfect placement, perfect timing!
Lovely drive! This is full outside off and Gill creams it through cover. Hit that uppishly, but it was in the gap
What a display from Sai Sudharsan this is! He is tearing into Shami here. He goes short around leg and Sudharsan swivels and pulls it fine on the leg side
And now a fourth! This is deftly played by Sudharsan. It's a lnegth ball on middle swinging and seaming away to finish just outside off. Sudharsan opens his face and steers this fine of short third
This time Shami goes on a length but outside leg. Sudharsan glances this fine of the keeper for the third boundary of the over
Short and wide and punished. Sudharsan frees his arms again and this time hammers a cut that beats NKR running to his left and putting in the dive from deep backward point
On a length on leg and slanted across him, Sudharsan pushes it towards cover

Thrashed through midwicket! This is a short of length ball on leg swinging and seaming away from Sudharsan, who stands tall, frees his arms and plays an authroitative pull in the gap between midwicket and mid-on
On a length outside off, tucked between midwicket and mid-on but Nitish Kumar Reddy dives to his right to stop that from racing away for four
Full on middle, Sudharsan flicks it away through square leg and they pick up two
Drops this length ball on middle towards midwicket for a quick single
Length ball on leg, Gill takes a few quick steps forward and parries to midwicket
Full outside off, Gill reaches out for the drive but is beaten on the outside edge
Length ball seams in from outside off, Sudharsan tucks it through square leg
On a length on leg, tucked fine to deep backward square
On a length on off and going across, cut to point on the bounce
On a length outside off, steered behind point
Gorgeous from Gill! Shami errs in line as this inswinger is going down leg. Gill gracefully flicks this behind square leg, balancing on his front leg and just helping the ball along
Gill pushes at a full ball outside off but gets an inside edge through square leg
Starts off with a full ball around middle, hint of swing into the left-hander. Flicked out to deep square leg
Toes a reverse sweep to point. Fullish ball landed outside leg
Loopy slow ball lands well outside leg on a length and spins away to beat the slog sweep. Goes off the back leg to point
Reddy's moved so far across he's on the grass. Gets followed by a fullish ball and beats him on the slog. Ball rolls towards short fine
Beaten on the reverse. The fullish ball landed outside leg and hit the front leg.

Rashid runs across from deep midwicket but the ball lands safely at midwicket. Ishant's down too. He slipped after following through. Was a low full toss on leg that Cummins tried to slog again, top edged it.

Leading edge off the slog goes high. Siraj runs in from long-on, Ishant goes back too... and tries to take it while looking back. Gets fingertips, that's all. Was a full toss and Cummins looked to go over midwicket
Short ball slips out of Rashid's hand. Reddy goes deep in the crease and pulls it. High and far over midwicket again. SRH well out but Rashid goes for 50 in three
Slog swept again. This just clears the midwicket boundary. Was a length ball on leg, goes 76 metres far
Bad ball. Short and very wide but Siraj prevents the boundary by sliding full length to the right at long-off. Cummins had flat-batted that decently
Cummins clears the front leg, lunges across and slog sweeps high over midwicket. Ten rows back, 85-metre six. Was a full ball on leg,
Goes back and clips a length ball on leg to deep square leg
Slow on a length down leg, Cummins makes room and miscues a pull to deep midwicket
Hard length over middle, pulled to deep square leg. 146ks
Fullish just outside off, Cummins looks to slog over long-on. Top edges it to the right of deep third. Buttler walks to the left to let the direct hit connect. But Cummins was in
Back of length at the body, tucked behind square
Goes across but backs away later. Coetzee goes hard length over the stumps, Reddy has enough room to cut. Rashid runs actoss from deep point for the catch but is half-volleyed to the left
Fullish down leg, Reddy walked across and tried to whip it fine. Missed it. Pace - 140ks
Into the pitch, at the body. Cummins pulls it off the bottom onto thigh and it rolls leg side
Back foot goes across before stepping back, the ball is full on leg. So, it didn't look like the bowler was affected. Flicked to deep square leg
Near-perfect yorker, was a touch down leg. Cummins tried to jam it down with a straight bat, got it off the bottom-left of the bat and it raced through fine leg
Good catch by Buttler, takes a step and dives far to the right to grab it with both gloves. Was a bumper just down leg, Kamindu tried to hook it fine and got it off the face of the bat.
Pulled straight to long-on. No celebrations, GT know they have this. Shortish ball on fourth, Aniket stood still and went for another flat-bat hit. Connection and placement not good enough
Siraj misses the yorker but cramps Aniket with the thigh-high full toss. It's on leg stump, an inside-edged slog across the line goes onto the thigh and pops into the pitch in front
Hard length over middle, Aniket clears the front leg but can't extend his arms. Flat-bats it into the pitch, back to the bowler
A bit of tail on that yorker. Seam's canting to first slip, the ball started going away but almost kissed the base of off after beating Aniket's swipe across the line
Prasidh ends with an economy of 4.75 in a 225 chase. Finishes with a near-yorker at 146ks, flicked along the ground to long-on
Very full, clipped along the ground to deep midwicket
Yorker on middle, punched to long-on

Appeal upheld this time, and that might be the game. Klaasen was hopping across laterally and Prasidh went hard length on fifth. Klaasen did get inside the line and tried to lap-pull it fine but got a thin inside edge. Ultra-Edge later confirms it was off glove. Buttler took a low catch and Prasidh jumps in delight. He has 100 T20 wickets

Gill is back on the field... and will review an lbw call. This looked close as Aniket walked to fourth stump and got beaten on the flick by a length ball. Hit him on the left edge of the front thigh. Pitching on fourth stump and... it'd go just over leg stump as per Hawk-Eye's prediction
Yorker on leg, clipped to deep midwicket

Siraj runs in from deep midwicket... and takes a low catch. Key batter gone. Was a 139ks length ball on middle and off, Abhishek slid leg side and looked to pull it aerially. Ball hit low on the sticker and went high, Siraj ran close to the edge of the ring and slid forward and caught it on the move. Took it to his right, knee got stuck in the grass too but he managed to hold on

Gets bat on it this time. Ump starts to signal six, then waits and signals four. Yep, that landed just a bit inside the boundary. Was another wide yorker attempted. Was a thigh-high full toss that Abhishek cut off the top edge
High full toss is outside the off-side tramline. Not too far from a no-ball. Abhishek took a step forward and then reached out with a horizontal bat. Missed it
Wide and full, Klaasen's in front of off as he reaches out to slash it over point. Toes it along the ground to short third
Wide and full, Klaasen has a swipe. Top-edges the cutter over backward point. Asking rate's still 16.72
Full on fourth, slapped along the ground to long-on
Yorker on off, whipped along the ground to long-on
A bit of width on the shortish ball, Abhishek has a heave across. Misses
Shortish ball on fourth, pulled along the ground to long-on's right

No direct hit at the non-striker's, so SRH steal a single. It's actually been reviewed for lbw by GT, looked like the yorker pitched outside leg. The batter was inside the crease and got hit right on the toe. Middle and off visible as the back foot was outside off - he was standing square-on. Got beaten on the flick and hit right in front of the big toe. The ball popped to the bowler's left, Prashidh charged across and threw it on the bounce. Looked like he'd have been short had it hit. No detail on pitching, impact's umpire's call. So, the decision stays.
Fullish on off, punched to cover
Abhishek makes room, so Prasidh goes full on fifth. The batter has to hurry across to the other side. Used his reach fully and bunted it with a diagonal bat to cover for a quick single
Drives the length ball along the ground, Gill slides at cover to deny the single
Squeezes the full ball out to long-off. Abhishek made room and got followed. Ball lobbed in air as the bat face opened on impact

Tewatia almost takes a stunning one-handed catch on the long-on boundary. He was jumping high, turning left but realised he was too close to the boundary. So, he pushed the ball with his palm rather than cling on. He falls on the ground but manages to bring the ball inside. Was a fullish ball outside off, met with a lofted off-drive with a decent connection
Dances down and looks to flash it over cover. Rashid goes a touch wide to get the edge, ball floats towards short third but doesn't carry
Stays still and clatters it over midwicket. High six. Length ball angling in towards middle,
Dances down, gets it on the low full toss and drives past the bowler. Four along the ground. Ball being at the stumps helped Abhishek
Starts on the fuller side of length, just outside off and gets a bit of turn away with the 97ks legbreak. Cut to deep point. Low bounce, slow off the pitch
Chops it from a shortish length outside off through point
Full outside off, slapped across to long-on

This is why the last shot was so remarkable. Abhishek looks to repeat it but missed the fullish length ball as he tried to flap it over short fine. Impact was just outside off as he was hit on the right leg while standing square-on with feet wide apart

Helped away over fine leg despite being too far inside the line. Abhishek gets fifty and points the toe of his bat towards the dugout, punches it a couple of times and gives a thumbs up. This full ball on middle and off would've had Abhishek plumb had he missed it. But the hand speed was terrific as he thrashed. Ball sails over fine leg
Pulls it off a length through cow corner. Along the ground. Line was around off
Length on fourth, punched to cover
Length on fourth, Klaasen backs away and cuts to deep point
Klaasen clears the front leg and pulls it high and far over midwicket. This didn't rise off the pitch and lost a lot of pace. Klaasen had to bend low to lift it
Makes room again, gets a quick length ball following him. Driven off the back foot down the ground. Not as much time to play the shot
Abhishek dances down and slays it over the bowler. Turned a length ball into a full ball, had a bit of room too and he drove down the ground
Ah, there's the old Rashid. Driving the ball into the pitch, getting the wrong'un towards leg. Pulled to deep square leg
Pitched up around off, driven to cover.
Back of length outside off, he stands tall and punches it out to sweeper cover
Abhishek tries to take on this length ball outside off and it goes off the inside edge to deep square leg
Short outside off, Klaasen pulls it out to deep square leg

Kishan's tortured innings comes to an end and Coetzee has his first wicket of the season! This is angled across Kishan again, who for the third ball in a row looks to mow it leg side. This time it's a leading edge and Prasidh Krishna at deep third moves to his right and takes it without much fuss
Kishan is struggling to time it today. This is full around off and going across, he again looks for a mighty heave and just gets an inside edge through fine leg. They do well to run two, though
Full around off, Kishan looks to swing it away but it goes off the inside half of the bat to midwicket
On a length on leg, Kishan looks to pull and gets an inside edge to short fine
Tossed full on leg, driven out to long-off
Slides this full ball down leg
Worked down to long-on for a single
Now Kishan looks to pull away this length ball on leg and ends up inside edging it onto his body
Abhishek dances down the crease as Washington tosses it up full around leg. Abhishek looks to swing it away but it goes off the inside half to deep midwicket
This is on a length around leg, Kishan pulls it out to deep square leg
On a length outside off, punched to point

Abhishek skies it again! This is a length ball outside off and again he slices it off the toe end. This clears mid-off and cover again but the two fielders combine well to save a run! First Siraj dives to keep the ball in. It's still rolling towards the boundary rope and Gill runs in and stops it
Back of length delivery outside off, Abhishek swings and misses

Abhishek takes on a back of length delivery outside off but ends up slicing it off the toe end and it goes high in the air. However, it gets enough distance to clear the cover and mid-off fielders running back
Top edge goes behind for four! This is short outside off, Abhishek swivels as he pulls and the top edge goes right over the keeper for a one-bounce four
Length ball angled across, Kishan steers it straight of the deep third fielder
Full around off, Kishan plays a lofted straight drive. Can't time it as well as he'd have liked and it bounces short of long-on running across
Kishan is backing away and Prasidh bowls a wide yorker to beat the bat as Kishan looks to squeeze it away. Excellent bowling
Short down leg, Abhishek pulls it very fine down leg to the fielder's left
Length ball slides down leg
On a length on leg, Kishan gets low to look to swing that away, but only manages to hit it out to long leg off the inside half of the bat
Dug in short on leg, Abhishek is backing away to try and take it on, but the bounce does him in. Abhishek adjusts to swipe it square on the leg side
On a length around leg, tucked to midwicket for a risky single
Short on leg, pulled to deep square leg
Kishan looks to take on this length ball outside leg and misses, getting hit on the thigh instead
Attempted yorker on leg, dug out to the leg side
Slashed over point. Abhishek backs away early and takes on this short length delivery around leg, cutting it square
On a length on leg, Abhishek works it to midwicket
On a length around leg, Kishan pushes it towards mid-on for a single
Abhishek backs away as Prasidh follows him with an attempted yorker. It's a low full toss in the end but Abhishek can't connect
Short of length outside off, Abhishek defends
On a length around off, Kishan punches it through point. Fifty up for SRH

Rashid Khan you beauty! Travis Head takes on this back of length delivery, he wants to maul this over midwicket, but it comes off the top edge. Rashid Khan in the deep is running to his right from deep square leg and then has to change directions slightly to go back and he judges it to perfection as he takes it while falling onto the ground. An excellent bit of fielding gets rid of the dangerous Travis Head
That's so smartly played! Looks to bowl a yorker outside off but Head has backed away and is able to squeeze it out in the gap between cover and point for four
Short around middle and going across, pulled along the carpet to mid-on
Length ball angles in from outside off, Abhishek keeps it out
Abhishek is only dealing in sixes here! Full outside off and Abhishek shimmies down the track and lofts it inside out over extra cover
Full around off, Head swings this along the ground to mid-on's left for a single
Full and wide, 141kph, it beats Head's attempted cut
Finds the gap this time for sure! This is overpitched outside off and Head launches it down the ground and well straight of mid-off
Full outside off, Head laces a drive hard to cover's left, but the fielder does well there to stop it
Ishant looks for the wide yorker but goes too wide

Yorker outside leg, Abhishek backs away and ends up squeezing it back to the bowler. Siraj collects and immediately throws down the stumps at the striker's end but Abhishek ensures he stays inside the crease. He isn't happy at that throw and seems to gesture something to the square leg umpire
On a length outside leg, Head looks to swipe it away but it goes off his hips to short fine leg
On a length on leg and going across, Head backs away and punches it hard but straight to the cover fielder on the bounce
That's more like it for Head! Back of a length on leg and going across, Head backs away and heaves this away between midwicket and mid-on
Bouncer on leg, Head looks to ramp but misses. Called wide on height immediately. Buttler collected that at full stretch above his head
Back of length outside leg, Head backs away and drops it towards cover
Back of a length on leg, Head defends and the ball bounces towards Buttler's left. They manage a quick run
The change in angle works in Abhishek's favour! This is overpitched outside off. Abhishek clears his front leg and hits another flat six over long-off. An expensive end to an otherwise good over
On a length around middle, Head looks to flick it leg side but it goes square off his pads
Abhishek skips out of his crease and Ishant goes short of length around off. Head adjusts to push it to cover for a quick run
Full around middle, Abhishek flicks it to short fine leg and wants a single but Head sends him back
Full on the pads, 141kph, Head looks to whip it away and it goes off his pads to Buttler's right
Full around off, 137kph, clipped to deep square leg's left
